posts.body:
Here
is a guide for how to use the web version of EasyRPG Player. I have never done it, and probably never will, so I won't be able to answer any questions you might have about it. Hope it helps.
ATT_Turan said:
But it doesn't really matter, these forums aren't permitted to discuss other game-making software.

The "Player" actually works with games that *were* made with RPG Maker. It's an open source replacement for the RPG_RT.exe file that is deployed with RM2K and RM2K3 games. I could be wrong, but I assume that it's okay to talk about here, since the mods have approved the release of
similar things
for other engines.
